title: Poker Range Analyzer
coverage_notes: 6-max No-Limit Hold'em preflop ranges by position.
UTG, MP, CO, BTN, and SB files are RFI/opening ranges.
BB file is documented upstream as a defense range versus BTN open.
Ranges include raise/call/fold frequencies by hand class.
This is not yet a complete tree for all facing-open, 3-bet, 4-bet, and cold-call situations.
